fields.label: Lead system
fields.description: Lead = ERPNext; CRM Lead = Frappe CRM. Install the selected app first.

fields.label: Intake secret
fields.description: Generate a random secret of at least 32 characters; set the same WEBSITE_INTAKE_SECRET on the website.

fields.label: New lead status
fields.description: Required for Frappe CRM: enter an existing CRM Lead Status (for example New). ERPNext defaults to Lead.

fields.label: Contact lead source
fields.description: Optional existing Lead Source / CRM Lead Source. Exact name.

fields.label: Assessment lead source
fields.description: Optional existing Lead Source / CRM Lead Source. Exact name.

fields.label: Sales follow-up owner
fields.description: Optional enabled System User with Website Manager TI and access to the selected lead system.
